description: This file defines functions to generate PDSCH (Physical Downlink Shared Channel) configuration parameters for different RNTI types in 5G NR, based on 3GPP TS 38.214 specifications. It includes functions for specific configurations such as TC-RNTI, C-RNTI, and variations with different parameters.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_tc_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config parameters for Type 1.0 TC-RNTI based on cell configuration and resource allocation.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_0_c_rnti
methods.description: Overloaded function generating PDSCH config for Type 1.0 C-RNTI, with optional serving cell config.

methods.name: get_pdsch_config_f1_1_c_rnti
methods.description: Generates PDSCH config for Type 1.1 C-RNTI, considering multiple codewords and dedicated DMRS info.
